title: Effects of Fresh Watermelon Consumption on Satiety and Cardiometabolic Health
official: Effects of Fresh Watermelon Consumption on Satiety and Cardiometabolic Health
summary: The goal of the proposed study is to determine the effects of fresh watermelon fruit consumption on satiety, metabolic parameters and weight management.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18-55 years old
* BMI 25-40

Exclusion Criteria:

* Smoker
* Pregnant woman
* Required dietary supplement use
* Required medication of metabolic disorders
* Allergy to watermelon or gluten
